user_story: As a guest, I want to see all my bookings so that I can review my reservations.

positive.title: Guest views bookings with existing reservations
steps: Navigate to the 'My Bookings' section after logging in
Verify the list of bookings is shown
positive.expected_result: The system displays all existing reservations for the guest account

positive.title: Guest sees detailed reservation information
steps: Click on a specific booking to view details
positive.expected_result: The system displays detailed information for the selected reservation

negative.title: Guest tries to view bookings without logging in
steps: Attempt to navigate to the 'My Bookings' section without logging in
negative.expected_result: The system prompts the user to log in before accessing the 'My Bookings' section

negative.title: Guest views bookings with an invalid session
steps: Wait for session to expire or manually invalidate session
negative.expected_result: The system denies access to the 'My Bookings' section and prompts the user to log in again

edge.title: Guest with no bookings visits the bookings page
steps: Navigate to the 'My Bookings' section with an account that has no bookings
edge.expected_result: The system displays a friendly message stating there are no bookings yet

edge.title: Guest views a large number of bookings
steps: Navigate to the 'My Bookings' section for an account with a large number of reservations (e.g., 1000 bookings)
edge.expected_result: The system efficiently loads and displays all bookings without performance issues
